name: vim-companion
title: Vim Companion
description: Search Vim commands and your Neovim keymaps using plain English.
author: wazp

commands.name: search-commands
commands.title: Search Vim Commands
commands.description: Find Vim commands and Neovim shortcuts by describing what you want to do.

commands.name: browse-keymaps
commands.title: Browse Keymaps
commands.description: Explore the mappings discovered from your Vim and Neovim configuration.

commands.name: refresh-keymaps
commands.title: Refresh Keymaps
commands.description: Re-detect editors and re-discover configured keymaps.

commands.name: environment-diagnostics
commands.title: Environment Diagnostics
commands.description: Show detected editors, configuration paths, leader keys, and discovery status.

preferences.name: preferredEditor
preferences.title: Preferred Editor
preferences.description: Which editor's mappings to show. Auto prefers Neovim when both are installed.

preferences.name: runtimeDiscovery
preferences.title: Runtime Discovery
preferences.description: How keymaps are discovered. Loading your configuration runs its startup code (plugins, autocommands) in a headless editor.

data.title: Safe: editor defaults only (no user config)

preferences.name: vimPath
preferences.title: Vim Executable
preferences.description: Absolute path to vim. Leave empty to search PATH.

preferences.name: nvimPath
preferences.title: Neovim Executable
preferences.description: Absolute path to nvim. Leave empty to search PATH.

preferences.name: nvimAppName
preferences.title: Neovim Configuration
preferences.description: NVIM_APPNAME profile (e.g. lazyvim) or an absolute config directory. Leave empty to use the environment default.

preferences.name: includeBuiltins
preferences.title: Sources
preferences.description: Search the curated Vim command reference.
preferences.label: Include built-in commands

preferences.name: includeCustom
preferences.description: Search mappings discovered from your editor configuration.
preferences.label: Include custom keymaps

preferences.name: includePlugins
preferences.description: Search mappings provided or declared by plugins.
preferences.label: Include plugin mappings

preferences.name: leaderOverride
preferences.title: Leader Key
preferences.description: Display override for <leader>, e.g. Space or ,. Leave empty to use the detected value.

preferences.name: resultLimit
preferences.title: Search Result Limit
preferences.description: Maximum number of results shown while searching.
